name: podcast-viral
description: Talking-head / podcast short: per-shot framing from the shot data (one face: center-crop + face track, two or more: center-crop + active speaker, screens: zoom-fit, graphics / no face: blur-fit), hormozi-pop captions (3 words a line) at 0.70 with one keyword a line highlighted, a big boxed hook title (<= 7 words) for the first 3 s, yellow progress bar, -14 LUFS. No automatic punch-ins: add them yourself where a moment earns it (`rustler effect add <clip> punch-in --start <s> --end <s> --amount 1.08`).

based_on.trial: clips-trial-1 (Vinh Giang x Raj Shamani, 5 clips, all QC pass)

notes: Framing follows layout_rules per shot from the smart defaults' shot plan (`rustler layout plan <clip> --apply`) or `rustler analyze faces <source_id>`; segments without shot data keep their framing (warning). The template does not run face tracking: a center-crop segment without a crop path gets the exact `rustler crop track-face` / `crop track-active` command in the warnings.
Write the hook title yourself (<= 7 words) with `rustler overlay add-text <clip> "..."`, then apply the template again to restyle it; or pass overrides {"hook": {"text": "..."}}.
No punch-ins are added automatically. Zoom only where a moment earns it, subtle and held for a phrase: `rustler effect add <clip> punch-in --start <s> --end <s> --amount 1.08`.
The trial found the hook text too small at 0.085; this template uses 0.1.
